name: Rafael Costa Lima
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the grandstands of Interlagos, where the roar of engines ignited a passion within him. After studying Human Resources, he specifically targeted motorsport teams, believing his skills could create a positive and efficient environment. He started in a smaller karting outfit before landing a role at Tickford Racing. Rafael's approach to HR goes beyond simply filling positions; he focuses on fostering a team culture where every member feels valued and empowered. 

His ability to spot potential and nurture talent has made him a valuable asset. He's known for his meticulous approach to recruitment, ensuring that every candidate aligns with the team's ethos. He's also spearheaded initiatives to improve employee well-being, recognizing that a happy team is a productive team. Rafael’s distinctive quality lies in his capacity to translate complex organizational needs into actionable strategies, always with the team's overall success in mind.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael is of average height, with a friendly and approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always has a thermos of chimarrão (mate tea) on his desk.
Memorizes everyone's birthday and sends a personalized card.
Organizes impromptu team-building exercises, even during busy race weeks.
